title: Which prefix? — the whole table, as practice

blocks.text: See below for a table the prefixes, their primary meanings, and the prepositions that accompany them, adapted from Muravyova.

head: prefix
primary meaning
prepositions
rows: Movement inwards across a threshold, entering. Antonym: вы-
Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting. Antonym: в-
из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat.
Intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion. Antonym: у-
в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen.
Intended departure, signals absence. Antonym: при-
в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen.
Withdrawal a short distance away. Antonym: под-
Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way
в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.
Movement across, through, or past something
сквозь / через / в + acc.; мимо + gen.; without preposition
Movement across, from one point to another; through
с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.
Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions
Movement onto the surface of an object
Convergent movement from various directions towards one center. Antonym: раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся)
Divergent movement in various directions from one center. Antonym: с-, со- (+сь, +ся)
по + dat. pl.; в + acc. pl.
Beginning of unidirectional movement (with unidirectional verb of motion)
в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen.; по + dat.
